thread:
emily: Short update 7 we've approved a further shift in the deprecation schedule for Legacy SDK (2.x/3.x). New EOL: 2027-01-31.
emily: Rationale: several regulated customers require extra validation windows and our migration tool needs more polish.
sam: Docs request: please pause the automatic redirect from /sdk/legacy to /sdk/latest. I'll publish a migration playbook and a compatibility reference.
noah: Engineering plan: add a temporary `legacyCompat` option in the upcoming 4.x line. It's opt-in and guarded by a feature flag. Intention: reduce churn while customers migrate.
tara: CS: we'll prepare a targeted campaign for top 40 customers and include a self-serve checklist + white glove offer. Need one-pager and email templates.
migrate-bot: release: redwood-migrator 1.1.0-beta -> `redwood-migrate --check` will output suggested diffs. docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/migrator/1.1.0-beta
emily: High-level deliverables and dates: 1) compat option PR (noah) by 2026-05-05; 2) migration playbook (sam) draft by 2026-05-20; 3) migrator docs and sample PRs (migrate-bot) by 2026-05-01; 4) CS outreach plan (tara) by 2026-05-10.
sam: Draft snippet for docs: ```
# python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), legacyCompat={"enabled": True})
# CLI
redwood-migrate --apply --files services/checkout
```
sam: I'll include a section "compatibility vs migration" with perf tradeoffs. Note: legacyCompat may add ~5-15% latency on small batch sizes and disables a few newer optimizations.
noah: Telemetry note: we'll expose a `legacy_compat=true` metric label if the flag is enabled. This is opt-in and will not include request payloads.
emily: Support runbook items: common failures to document - auth header name changes, streaming param differences, retry semantics. Tara, please coordinate with Support to author KB entries.
tara: Will do. Also adding templates for customer emails, and a step-by-step rollback plan for those on private deployments.
ops-bot: staging docs site updated: https://staging.docs.redwood.dev/migration-playbook-2165432100 (staging token required).
sam: Action items recap: - Sam: publish migration playbook draft by 2026-05-20 - Noah: PR for legacyCompat by 2026-05-05 - Tara: CS outreach + templates by 2026-05-10 - Support: runbooks + KB by 2026-05-15
emily: We'll post a short announcement to #general once the playbook and CS templates are ready. Please leave suggested public wording here before we go live.
sam: Draft public blurb: "We are extending the deprecation timeline for Legacy SDKs to Jan 31, 2027. To support migrations we are providing an opt-in compatibility flag and a migration CLI. See the migration playbook for guidance or contact support for assistance."
tara: Minor edit: add "temporary" before compatibility flag and mention targeted outreach to high-usage accounts.
noah: Engineering reminder: legacyCompat will not re-enable deprecated telemetry or older sampling behavior. We'll call that out prominently.
emily: Great. Thanks team — will follow up with the announcement draft and pinned checklist.
